# Historical Scene execution audit

**Provenance.** All citations below refer to expanded files under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/ablation_r1/ours_without_regression_guidance/C1/test/`. Their archive is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/ablation_r1--ours_without_regression_guidance.tar.gz`; the corresponding member path replaces the expanded prefix through `outputs/` with `experiments/`. Citations give source ID, remaining file path and exact lines.

## Metalworking shop — commons_155212263

- **Representation and intent.** Step 2 builds benches from boxes; wheels from segmented tube rims and five curved spokes; a lathe from bed, shaft and bearings; and an anvil from stepped boxes and tapered rods. Vices, drawer, tools and containers are separate grouped parts. The comments describe an uncalibrated camera and a timeout-oriented simplification—not proof of a prior failure in the supplied results (X0337, `steps/002/build.py`, lines 5–15, 58–70, 72–118, 120–161, 202–214).
- **Materials and revision.** Step 2 creates a procedural brick-and-bump floor and emissive pale glass. Step 3 changes floor coordinates from Object to Geometry Position and reduces mortar size, intending to correct an oversized pattern. Material assignment is attempted through named mesh descendants; the log does not separately validate its visual effect (X0337, `steps/002/build.py`, lines 235–292; X0339, `steps/003/build.py`, lines 230–286).
- **Camera and execution.** Step 3 moves the camera from `(5.7,-7.2,4.4)` to `(4.7,-4.7,3.65)`, retains a 36 mm lens, and aims lower. The script requests 512×384, Cycles, 24 samples and denoising; both result logs instead report 16/16 samples, finished PNG and saved blend, with `ok: true` and empty stderr. The task metadata also specifies 512×384 (X0337, `steps/002/build.py`, lines 302–316; X0339, `steps/003/build.py`, lines 288–309; X0338, `steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0340, `steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0341, `task.json`, lines 2–5). No selection or acceptance record for this scene is supplied.

## Electronics bench — commons_16007442

- **Failure and repair.** Step 1 timed out after approximately 600 seconds with no image or captured output. Step 2 explicitly targets construction cost by batching cuboid details and using lightweight curves; it then reports a finished render and saved blend. Step 3 also reports success (X0347, `steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0348, `steps/002/build.py`, lines 6–15, 329–382; X0349, `steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0351, `steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7).
- **Generated scene.** The selected build uses grouped boxes and rods for monitor, oscilloscope, meters and lamp; keyboard keys and cabinet labels are batched meshes, and leads are beveled poly curves. The lamp has a base, upright, arm, shade, diffuser and cord. Batched finishes use Principled colors and roughness `.70`, not image textures (X0350, `steps/003/build.py`, lines 71–110, 129–160, 180–194, 211–221, 289–319, 326–376).
- **Framing and actual render.** Step 3 changes the lens from 43 to 49 mm at the same camera position and target, seeking a tighter crop. It requests Eevee, 512×388, Standard view and two area lights; the execution log instead shows a 16-sample render pipeline, so the requested engine should not be assumed to be the executed engine. The task metadata is 512×388 (X0348, `steps/002/build.py`, lines 384–402; X0350, `steps/003/build.py`, lines 378–399; X0351, `steps/003/result.json`, line 5; X0352, `task.json`, lines 2–5).
- **Selection and validation.** `selected.json` selects step 3, although the record’s `selected` field is null. The record reports valid and functional passes for the bench lamp, overall `0.4410`, SSIM `0.1397`, and LPIPS `0.6990`; it expressly limits functional interpretation to structural/edit operability, with semantic completeness and support collision truth null (X0344, `selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0343, `record.json`, lines 16–34, 56–57).

## Dormitory — commons_163096530

The provided final build models three bunk assemblies, locker, fireplace and architecture using boxes, rods and filleted bedding. It copies materials per mesh and adds noise/ramp/bump treatments to wood and masonry; dark bunk parts receive metallic settings. It requests a 33 mm camera, two area lights, Cycles 32 samples, denoising and 512×341 output (X0353, `build.py`, lines 29–94, 96–154, 182–246, 248–273). Step 3 is recorded as selected; the record reports completion, valid and architecture functional passes, overall `0.4203`, SSIM `0.1455`, and LPIPS `0.7353`, but null collision truth and semantic completeness. No individual execution result is supplied here (X0355, `selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0354, `record.json`, lines 16–34, 49–57).

**Limit:** Coordinates and claimed support heights do not establish physical contact. No images are attached, so visual fidelity cannot be independently assessed; successful rendering and recorded numeric acceptance are not proof of reconstruction quality.
